title: A Decision-Focused, Fairness-Constrained Framework for Multi-Horizon Graft-Rejection Prediction and Equitable Kidney Allocation
description: Reproducibility code and seed-fixed synthetic generator for the manuscript submitted to IEEE Transactions on Artificial Intelligence. Includes multi-horizon survival models, conformal uncertainty, a decision-focused (SPO+) allocation experiment tested end-to-end against the fair, feasibility-constrained objective (with the finding that the SPO+ advantage does not survive the equity and feasibility constraints), and a NOTTO-inspired fairness benchmark, plus real-data analysis scripts for the openly licensed UCI CKD and Mendeley kidney-allograft datasets.
